name: pulse-review-quality-gate
description: Reviews completed React component work in this Laravel Inertia app. Use before finalizing component changes to check requirements, architecture, API, accessibility, design system, Motion, performance, tests, browser behaviour, documentation, and maintainability.
purpose: Catch regressions and missing verification before reporting completion.
inputs: Required: - Changed files. - Requirements or intended behaviour. Optional: - Test results. - Browser logs. - Build output. - Screenshots.
outputs: - Findings by severity when reviewing. - Completion checklist. - Verification summary. - Residual risks.
responsibilities: Check design system, Motion, performance, media, tests, and documentation.
non_responsibilities: Performing large new refactors during review.
success_criteria: The skill stays within its focused responsibility.
The workflow and decision points are followed.
Validation checklist items are satisfied or skipped checks are reported.
Cross-skill handoffs are explicit when another skill owns the next concern.
validation_criteria: SKILL.md loads as the entry point.
AGENTS.md provides the compiled agent guide.
